description: Search HenryKnows' knowledge base (regulations, SEVP/USCIS guidance, Federal Register rules, and HenryKnows' own explanatory notes, which are labelled "HenryKnows note" and link the source they rest on) and get the matching passages with their source links, so you can read and cite the text yourself. Fast; no model call and no web search. Read-only: nothing is stored.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. a rule, form or topic ("OPT unemployment days", "8 CFR 214.2(f)(10)"), with no names or ID numbers.

name: search_sources
title: Search HenryKnows sources
